title: Change how cents are rounded
blurb: A shared helper. The change ripples up through tax and checkout to the receipt.
diff:
diff --git a/src/shopkit/money.py b/src/shopkit/money.py
index 27cc646..ceba6bb 100644
--- a/src/shopkit/money.py
+++ b/src/shopkit/money.py
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@ from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
 
 def round_cents(amount):
     """Round a dollar amount to whole cents, halves up."""
-    return float(Decimal(str(amount)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
+    return float(Decimal(str(amount)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding="ROUND_DOWN"))

title: Raise California's tax rate
blurb: A data change outside any function. Every test that runs code in tax.py is selected.

title: Normalise product codes on add
blurb: TestCart builds its catalog once in setup_class, before its tests run. All three tests depend on Catalog.add even though none of them calls it.

title: Edit the CSV export
blurb: No test runs this function, so the memory can't say what depends on it. repomap says so instead of reporting zero impact.
diff:
diff --git a/src/shopkit/export.py b/src/shopkit/export.py
index cd5f345..9eaee4a 100644
--- a/src/shopkit/export.py
+++ b/src/shopkit/export.py
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 def to_csv(cart):
     """Old CSV export. Nothing in the test suite calls it."""
-    rows = ["sku,qty,price"]
+    rows = ["sku,quantity,price"]
     for sku, qty in sorted(cart.lines.items()):
         rows.append(f"{sku},{qty},{cart.catalog.price_of(sku)}")
     return "\n".join(rows)
